description: Execute any single canonical editor action (all 189+ actions) or read/inspection tool (list_layers, inspect_layer, query_transcript, list_sources, search_shots, shot_timeline, read_source_transcript, measure_audio, measure_picture, measure_color) directly on a project scene without autonomous_edit. Pass video_url or assets on the first call to bootstrap a new project.

action.description: Canonical action name (e.g. REGISTER_REMOTE_ASSET, SET_SOURCE_RANGE, TRIM_LAYER, REMOVE_SILENCES, CONFIGURE_CANVAS, VERTICAL_REFRAME, COLOR_GRADE, APPLY_VFX, TITLE_CARD, PLAN_MOTION_GRAPHICS, GENERATE_CAPTIONS, STYLE_CAPTIONS, CLEAN_AUDIO, GENERATE_VOICEOVER, GENERATE_MUSIC, ADD_SFX, AUTO_DUCK, RENDER_PREVIEW, EXPORT_VIDEO) or read tool name (e.g. list_layers, query_transcript).

action_params.description: Parameters for the canonical action (see get_action_schema).

assets.description: Optional media assets to seed a new project.

include_scene.description: If true, include the full raw scene JSON in the response (omitted by default in favor of liveLayers).

project_id.description: Project id for state persistence across calls.

video_url.description: Optional source video URL to seed a new project.

name: execute_action
title: Execute canonical editor action
